displayName: Record seals: backlog or stale sweeper

conditions.displayName: Every observed cycle nonempty for two hours

documentation.content: Unsealed record_pending sample is nonempty for two hours, an observed unsealed finish is over four hours old, or no successful sweep for 30 minutes. Sample counts/ages are lower bounds at the 128-job discovery cap. Inspect aggregate dispositions and CronJob status; never clear upload_failed or attest producers stopped. Lead owns worker-image/chart deploy and kill switch. See backend/deploy/record-seal-sweeper/README.md.

displayName: Record seals: bare producer token requires operator

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="prod-omi-backend" AND resource.labels.container_name="sweeper" AND jsonPayload.logger="record-seal-sweeper" AND jsonPayload.message:"\"event\": \"record_seal_sweep\"" AND jsonPayload.message=~"\"bare_token_skips\": [1-9][0-9]*"

documentation.content: A pre-identity producer token was skipped. Only an explicitly authorized operator can attest producers stopped. Do not print IDs or token maps. See backend/deploy/record-seal-sweeper/README.md.
